behavior: Explicit raw_input defaults false and prepends only the original audited stem to all12layer parts.
Only original raw feature bytes and original embedded final expected values are loaded; raw mode never downloads/loads intermediate stage goldens.
Each actual ONNX output directly feeds the next part. Deliberately wrong prefix output reaches final comparison unchanged and fails.
Independent native chain retains physical layout and must match the untouched native whole graph exactly.
First-part wrapper uses qualified twoConv/twoLayerNorm/oneprojection stem; body keeps chosen explicit audited variant and original coefficients.
Final cut must be actual original graph output, including the padded210row crop. No truncation to an earlier cut.
Requesting raw mode and actually executing its prefix are separate receipt flags. Partial failures retain incomplete evidence, never whole/GPU pass.
Original frozen-endpoint mode, strict reference tolerances, default native/ONNX generation and product Runtime remain unchanged.
